author: Guerrilla Miniature Games
description:
With the Broken Truth boxed set all painted up, Bob and I move on to the Grimdark Future Campaign System. Starting you off at 1000pts and compatible with the Narrative Campaign packs, this 'grow format' Campaign lets you play games as you go and paint units over time. 

With two new armies picked out and our first 1000pts all painted up, it's time to throw down!

Check out all the rules free HERE: https://onepagerules.com/games/grimdark-future

GMG is publicly supported. Become a backer on Patreon to ensure new content and that the Studio can continue: https://www.patreon.com/guerrillaminiaturegames 

Join us on DISCORD: https://discord.com/invite/XTqqxctryq

Want to challenge Ash to a game? Email him at GuerrillaMiniatureGames@gmail.com or message him through his Facebook Page!

Follow Ash on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/outofthebasementintothestreets

GMG Measuring Gauges and Tokens available HERE: http://deathraydesigns.com/product-category/accessories/guerrilla-miniature-gam
